method: H100 80GB; exact upstream baseline eb73a50b1d6183deb1d79ca425677bd0cf93342f versus one PR at a time; 10 alternating AB/BA paired samples; CUDA events around 20 replays of 32-operation graphs; distributed samples use max of all eight rank durations. Secondary run: 80 replays of eight-operation graphs. Warmup, correctness checks, dispatch observations and native weight preparation are outside timing. Synthetic tensor values/routing at real model dimensions, same inputs/weights in each pair. One separate isolated model was resident but idle throughout, with ownership/queue guards. Padding per-forward metadata staging and communicator initialization are outside the measured component seams. No serving workload, model quality or tokens/s/user claim is made.
